Drugs and finance go together like peanut butter and jelly and drugs. Or do they? In this investigation, Dan Toomey and the Good Work Investigative News Team_ look into whether Wall Street is truly on the stuff or not. 

Featuring interviews with: 

Alex Saeedy, Reporter at the Wall Street Journal. Follow Alex here: https://x.com/ajsaeedy 

Turney Duff, Former Investment Banker and Author of The Buy Side. Follow Turney here: https://www.instagram.com/turneyduff13/?hl=en

A bunch of anonymous finance employees.
